title: Upcoming Webinar: Navigating Respiratory Clinical Trials: Ensuring Endpoint Integrity with Spirometry, HRCT, and Patient-Centered Outcomes
summary: Register for this webinar to explore key considerations for optimizing respiratory clinical trials.
body_markdown:
In the rapidly evolving landscape of respiratory clinical development, it is crucial to align cutting-edge strategies with robust trial design. Respiratory clinical trials require reliable endpoints that capture treatment effects while keeping patients at the center.


This webinar will examine key considerations for optimizing respiratory clinical trials, with a focus on the essential role of spirometry, high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT), and patient-centered outcomes. Gain practical insights for integrating spirometry, HRCT, and patient-centered outcomes within respiratory trials. Understand how these critical endpoints are pivotal across various indications and learn strategies to reduce variability and maintain consistency throughout the trial process.


The expert panel will explore a comprehensive overview of:


- **Spirometry:** Fundamental applications in clinical trials, measurement techniques, validation and training, and patient support strategies to optimize data accuracy and reliability
- **HRCT:** The value of historical scans, establishing quantitative endpoints, and the advantages of central over-read processes to enhance data quality and consistency
- **Patient-Centered Outcomes:** The importance of patient-reported outcomes (PROs), quality-of-life assessments, the role of ePROs, and strategies to support site and patient compliance


Join Medpace to learn how integrated endpoint strategies can generate reliable, decision-ready data in respiratory clinical trials. Register today to secure your spot.


[Register Now](https://xtalks.com/webinars/navigating-respiratory-clinical-trials-ensuring-endpoint-integrity-with-spirometry-hrct-and-patient-centered-outcomes/)
